metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Giles Crutchstep
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Giles Crutchstep is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as determined crutch user with wrapped base lobe and lists two short padded crutches held by goo hands, clean base wrap as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Give me one more step.

records.name: Cora Caseclosed
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Cora Caseclosed is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as impatient resident wearing an arm cast and lists smooth white cast held in a simple blue sling as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Can I sign my own cast?

records.name: Theo Seatbrake
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Theo Seatbrake is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as relieved resident in a compact transport chair and lists small manual chair with two readable wheels, full dark blob settled in seat as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The good wheel is on this side.

records.name: Rory Strapcheck
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Rory Strapcheck is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as anxious resident with a side support and lists smooth curved brace on one lower lobe and one short grab handle as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Is this strap meant to squeak?

records.name: Wes Slowturn
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Wes Slowturn is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as weary resident with a wrapped head and cane and lists clean partial head wrap and simple wood cane as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I'll get there. I've started.

records.name: Faye Firstwalk
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Faye Firstwalk is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as gleeful resident making progress with a walker and lists short rounded walker with simple sturdy frame and two feet clearly visible as hardware as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That counts as a lap.
